description:
Salvaged deliverable 1 of the fz-kdt.13 build (its deliverable 2 was refuted
by measurement -- see fz-kdt.13). FactKey::CallGraphComponent(f) = smallest
FunctionId in f's strong component over the StaticCallees edge facts; equal
ids iff mutually reachable. Job::DeriveRecursive RENAMED
Job::DeriveCallGraphComponent, publishing BOTH CallGraphComponent(f) and
Recursive(f) from the one walk it already does (a split job would ADD ~200
evaluations on 00420; folding costs zero). Recursive becomes
component.len()>1 || self-edge; reaches_self deleted.

Measured: DeriveRecursive-family counts byte-identical to the fz-kdt.56 pins
(62/24, 73/12, 134/34) -- the recursion answer now costs nothing beyond the
component derivation. Remaining blocked completions (24/12/34) are the pull's
layered StaticCallees discovery, which no formulation avoids.

Consumers of mutual-reachability queries (whenever a future ticket needs
same-SCC classification) read CallGraphComponent facts; measured component
structure on 00420: 119 nodes, 116 components, largest = 3
({reduce_cont, reduce_step, lambda}).
title: Call-graph component fact: recursion from strong components, kdt.56 residual retired
